issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְצַלְעוֹת הַבַּיִת וְהָעֻבִּים' means 'and the side chambers of the house and the buttresses/pilasters' (or 'the side walls and the projecting frames'). The Chinese renders 'צַלְעוֹת' as '肋骨' (ribs) and 'הָעֻבִּים' as '雲彩' (clouds), which are incorrect. 'עֻבִּים' (from עֹב) refers to projecting frames/buttresses, not clouds. This changes the architectural description into something nonsensical.
